evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes. Is now a good time? [Rep does not wait for clear affirmation, pivots immediately to their agenda.]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I also would like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?

evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection offered. Customer's concern (price) is acknowledged but not summarized back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one-bedroom apartment), floor/stories (fourth floor source, fifth floor destination), rooms confirmed (one-bedroom), walking distances (multiple school-bus proxies), elevator access, no appliances, no heavy items, no boxes — all covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: For a typical one bedroom apartment we usually expect to see around fifteen to 25 boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: $770 to $990 for 3.5 to 4.5 hours, personalized to 'from a fourth floor apartment with no boxes and a long walk. Moving to a fifth floor apartment.'

evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly to 'Does that make sense so far?' and customer responds with 'I'm gonna cancel' — no explicit 'does that feel fair' framing or pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill and the way the clock work is the time start as soon as we get on site and open the contract.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: We have no worries damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages. [Framing is present but does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print' or 'built into the rate.']
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. Moves to booking logistics.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Do you have any questions or anything for me? [Throwaway phrasing, not 'What's still concerning you?']
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Customer volunteers 'I'm gonna cancel' and requests more time; rep accommodates without an ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No deposit required if you have to reschedule, or cancel no fees for that either.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Email address confirmed (Dong Ju 0101@gmail.com). No date, phone number, arrival window, or crew size confirmed. Customer declined to proceed at time of call.
